::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 5th [1869]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Mrs Caroline Fairclough/18
:::

My dear [Arthur](people/person_238.qmd)
Since you are so good to [Polly](other_books/otherbook_348.qmd), here are the two chapters you missed come in pursuit of you. You see her <u>lls</u> have exhausted the printers’ whole stock which accounts for the odd appearance of the latter sheet

I do not know if it is a monstrous presumption to treat those Italian articles that get compounded with the prepositions as representing the lost instrumental and locative cases- The French grammar claims <u>en</u> (in the) as so doing and surely <u>nel</u> answers to that.

Please return them to me, instead of obeying 

[rest of letter missing]

---

**Note:** Black-edged paper.
